ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels across approximately 90% of the visible ventral surface, contrasted by a thin low-intensity (black) boundary along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity band following the 2D contour of the trailing edge. A singular, small, circular low-intensity focal spot is located on the left lobe, mid-ventral. Minimal dark mottling at distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an obtuse interior angle and low bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations detected along the outer margins of both lobes, becoming less distinct and smoother approaching the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to sharp points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, tan/brown pixel groups at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with localized barnacle presence.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Peripheral barnacle clusters attached to the trailing edge at the distal-most points of both lobes.
